description.value: Plugs in the wrist or head to allow you to connect to machines/systems hands-free.

information.notes:
Mama Voodoo

Lieutenant · Netrunner fixer · Heywood

Tied to the Voodoo Boys, trades data and gigs on the Net. In meatspace — a heavyset woman in an armchair with a cyberdeck, surrounded by candles and monitors.

Tactics: Interface 6. Fights only through the Net: kills cameras, locks doors, jams Agents.

HP 45 · Seriously Wounded 23 · Death Save 5

Made with the “Night City · Interactive Map” module. Art is up to you.
